subject: CS475
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. English coverage is strong across all topics with highly relevant and popular videos. Arabic coverage is good for the Sensor Framework, Geolocation, and MapView topics, but lacks specific content for Sensor Coordinate Systems and Motion Sensor Data Filtering, where candidates were either too general or in the wrong context.

coverage.note: All candidates are either general math tutorials on coordinate systems or about using GPS, not programming the Android sensor coordinate system. All fail relevance gate.
No candidate reached 3000 views; selected highest-view video over 500 per exception rule.
Candidates are either basic introductions to sensors or discuss data filtering in unrelated contexts (SQL, R). None cover filtering or fusion of Android motion sensor data. All fail relevance gate.

videos.title: App to retrieve three dimensional position of Android Device using Sensors
videos.filter_reason: Clear demonstration of retrieving 3D position data from sensors, which is a core application of the sensor coordinate system.

videos.title: #4 SensorEventListener : Android Sensor Programming
videos.topic_ar: إطار عمل مستشعرات أندرويد ودورة الحياة
videos.filter_reason: A focused tutorial on implementing SensorEventListener and its callback methods, which are central to the Android Sensor Framework.

videos.title: Handling Location Permissions - MVVM Running Tracker App - Part 9
videos.topic_ar: واجهة برمجة تطبيقات تحديد الموقع والصلاحيات
videos.filter_reason: Excellent, focused tutorial from a reputable instructor on handling location permissions, a key challenge in using the Geolocation API.

videos.title: Android Maps: Part 4: Overlays
videos.filter_reason: Comprehensive tutorial covering various types of map overlays like circles and polylines, not just markers, with high view count.

videos.title: Sensor Fusion on Android Devices: A Revolution in Motion Processing
videos.filter_reason: An authoritative and highly-viewed Google TechTalk that specifically covers sensor fusion on Android devices, directly addressing the topic.

videos.title: Hardware| light sensor جهاز استشعار الضوء | android 111 دورة اندرويد
videos.topic_ar: إطار عمل مستشعرات أندرويد ودورة الحياة
videos.filter_reason: A clear, practical example of using the light sensor, which effectively demonstrates the core concepts of the Sensor Framework and listeners.

videos.title: تحديد احداثيات موقع المستخدم من الـ GPS، وتعلم اعطاء الصلاحيات..
videos.topic_ar: واجهة برمجة تطبيقات تحديد الموقع والصلاحيات
videos.filter_reason: This is the most relevant video, explicitly teaching how to get GPS coordinates and handle the necessary permissions in Android.

videos.title: 53- Android Pokemon || Add Marker- عرض صورة الاعب على الخريطة
videos.filter_reason: Excellent, practical tutorial on adding a custom image marker to a map, which is a core part of creating custom overlays.
